evidence.title: GitHub - testing-library/react-testing-library: 🐐 Simple and complete React DOM testing utilities that encourage good testing practices. · GitHub

name: React Testing Library
summary: Lightweight React DOM testing utilities that query the DOM the way users interact with it.
description: Testing utilities built on react-dom and react-dom/test-utils: render a component and find elements by role, label or text — the way users do — instead of reaching into component instances, so tests survive refactors. Installed from npm as a devDependency; from version 16 @testing-library/dom is required too, and @testing-library/jest-dom adds matchers. The docs site hosts guides and runnable examples with react-redux, react-router and react-context.
contains: queries the DOM by role, label and text instead of component internals
distributed via npm as a devDependency
@testing-library/dom required from v16; jest-dom adds matchers
examples with react-redux, react-router and react-context
